meaning:
an emblematic name of Egypt
Another name of mits.ra.yim (מִצְרַ֫יִם "Egypt" H4714G)
This name means pride, arrogance

elsewhere.note: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
